cites.quote: starts late in the evening in Asia/Kolkata
The Last visit date is the calendar date in the hospital time zone `Asia/Kolkata`.

findings.text: S-1 AC3 tests with a late-evening IST start time. Asia/Kolkata is UTC+05:30, so a late-evening IST time falls on the same UTC date. The IST and UTC dates only differ for start times between 00:00 and 05:30 IST, so this criterion cannot catch the time-zone bug.
